basis: Human-reviewed V0.4.4 provisional evidence from the 159-PDF seed backfill. Canonical unit is a fact, not a PDF. One anchor becomes CANONICAL; corroborating proposal rows are append-only REJECTED as superseded duplicates.

facts.fact_text: 2026年上半年，公司仿生机器人机电执行器核心产品稳步推进批量交付与产线爬坡。
facts.decision_rationale: Primary half-year report is anchor; IR and action-plan disclosure corroborate the same batch-delivery fact. No named Tesla/Optimus link.

facts.decision_rationale: Company-specific robot reducer business statement is relevant but low-level; no customer/order/Optimus link.

facts.fact_text: 公司披露机器人核心部件业务进入交付放量期。
facts.component_domain: frameless motors / coreless motors / joint modules / dexterous hands
facts.decision_rationale: Commercial delivery milestone is affirmative. The same record explicitly denies the Tesla acquisition rumor; therefore Tesla link remains 0.

facts.fact_text: 公司持续聚焦具身机器人赛道，并推动微型传动与驱动系统在灵巧手、机器人关节等场景中的应用。
facts.decision_rationale: Company-specific product/business relevance is supported; generic industry 'functional validation' language is not treated as a customer-validation milestone.

facts.fact_text: 公司具身智能业务继续高速增长，累计出货量位居行业前列，机器人灵巧手、关节模组等相关产品批量交付并贡献收入增量。
facts.decision_rationale: Full half-year report is anchor; report summary and IR record corroborate the same realized shipment/batch-delivery fact.

facts.component_domain: motors / joint modules / dexterous hands / linear drive
facts.decision_rationale: Official half-year report provides quantified realized robot-parts revenue.

facts.decision_rationale: Existing unnamed world-known technology-company relationship is supported. T2 is an unnamed-head-customer clue, not a named Tesla/Optimus relationship.

facts.decision_rationale: Official half-year report supports product application relevance; no customer/order/Optimus claim.

facts.fact_text: 报告期内，公司机器人业务订单规模增长，带动产能利用率持续改善。
facts.decision_rationale: Full half-year report is anchor; quality-improvement report corroborates the same order-growth fact.

facts.fact_text: 公司已累计服务全球超过1,000家机器人客户，并持续推动3D视觉产品在多类型机器人及具身智能场景中的商业落地。
facts.decision_rationale: Robot customer/commercial relevance is supported. Generic 'head robot customers' does not establish any Tesla/Optimus link, so the T0 anchor governs the canonical fact.

reject_only.reason: The match is a related-party/company-name and property-rental context, not a robot commercialization fact.
Fund-raising project background is not used as a standalone current commercialization milestone; the order-growth fact is canonicalized separately.
